codex_consult.feedback_summary: Two consultations. ROUND 1 (pre-implementation): Q1 city_context per-OPTION (not slot-level) since transit/city-change/red-eye days have differing roles per option; Q2 per-day day.stage with blocking_stage=min for gating + furthest_stage=max for display only; Q3 require explicit skipped:true with matching reason, never auto-mutate, dinner>=21:00 is late_arrival_placeholder NOT skipped; bonus: keep legacy schemas valid in M2, build v2 separately, LEGACY_SHAPE_FORBIDDEN scoped to v2 documents only. ROUND 2 (post-implementation review): flagged 7 issues — (1) JSON Schema not run [REAL BUG, fixed via scripts/lib/trip_contract/json_schema.py + integration in validate_day_v2/validate_meta_v2]; (2) day-type tolerance over-mandates: city-change/transit-only should not REQUIRE skips, only PERMIT them [REAL BUG, fixed via _permissive_reasons_for_day_type table + removed transit-only mandatory skips]; (3) skip-reason matching not enforced [REAL BUG, fixed via SKIP_REASON_MISMATCH rule]; (4) meal floor formula correct (2*non_skipped_count); (5) selected_option_id existence not verified [REAL BUG, fixed via SELECTED_OPTION_ID_NOT_IN_OPTIONS + OPTION_ID_DUPLICATE rules]; (6) category schemas unused in validation [DOCUMENTED in M2-contract.md as design choice — category extension fields are M3 agent self-validation]; (7) missing departure/transit-only/buffer fixtures + --fixtures exit code wrong [FIXED, added 3 fixtures + EXPECTED_FAIL_FIXTURES classifier]. On the demote-dependency question codex agreed with my approach (no auto-demote of downstream days) but required documentation [DONE in M2-contract.md §6].
